meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 召集多个互相对抗的AI反复挑刺,只留下站得住的判断,再整理成可执行方案。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果关键决策容不得想当然,想先被自己的假设挑一遍刺。
copy.tagline_en: Stress-test a plan with adversarial AI critics, then turn the survivors into steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a decision is too important to get wrong and you want your assumptions attacked first

howto.what: Claude 会当上 5 人对抗团队的 Lead,让成员互相攻击彼此的结论,只留下经得起攻击的洞见,再强制移交给 plan agent 写成可执行计划。它会先宣告模式已启用。
howto.when: 当规划需要最高严谨度、要暴露薄弱假设、盲点或过度设计时触发;提到 “hyperplan”、“hpp” 等关键词也会进入。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我规划这个方案
say.note: 需 team-mode 已启用,否则会停下提示

say.text: hpp:让 5 个成员互相攻击,挑出过度设计
say.note: 成员互评后只保留站得住的洞见

say.text: /hyperplan 规划这次迁移,重点找边缘情况
say.note: 最终计划由 plan agent 产出

howto.what_en: Claude becomes Lead of a 5-member adversarial team: members attack each other's findings, only defensible insights survive, then a plan agent must turn them into an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots or over-engineering; triggers include 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan'.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan this approach for me
say_en.note: Requires team-mode enabled, else it stops and tells you

say_en.text: hpp: have the 5 members attack each other and cut over-engineering
say_en.note: Only insights surviving cross-critique are kept

say_en.text: /hyperplan plan this migration, focus on edge cases
say_en.note: The plan agent produces the final plan
